content.value: . The primary and secondary windings of a 30 KVA, 76000/230 V, 1-phase transformer have resistance of 10 Ω and 0.016 Ω respectively. The reactance of the transformner referred to the primary is 34 Ω. Calculate the primary voltage required to circulate full-load current when the secondary is short circuited. What is the power factor on short circuit?
